criteria.requirement: Implement statemachine.async_runner.AsyncMachineRunner using completed EventCall validation, EventResult and snapshots. dispatch awaits actual activate_initial_state and send only when awaitable, records actual completed states/results and supports normal sync machines. run accepts sync or async event sources, stays lazy, awaits one event before reading the next, stable indices and collect only TransitionNotAllowed. Propagate cancellation, callback and source errors. No nested asyncio.run, hidden threads, tasks or no-op guard shortcuts; preserve actual lifecycle and callback parameter isolation.
